name: Gomer
overview: The name Gomer appears in Scripture in multiple contexts: first as a son of Japheth, from whom a people descended, as recorded in Genesis 10:2-3 and 1 Chronicles 1:5-6, highlighting his role in the genealogies of nations. Ezekiel 38:6 references Gomer and his bands, indicating a collective people associated with Togarmah. Additionally, Gomer is the name of the wife or concubine of the prophet Hosea, who bore him a son, as described in Hosea 1:3. These references collectively show Gomer as both an ancestral figure in the nations and a personal figure within God's prophetic narrative.
